From Death Thirteen · Price: it needs a sleeping target.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: You can enter the dream of a sleeping creature within 30 ft and talk with it. Surge, 2 actions: a creature within 30 ft falls asleep (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{unconscious} for 1 round on a failure, 1 minute on a critical failure; damage or an ally's Interact wakes it.
  • 5: Surge: in the dream, your stand attacks the creature: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}).
  • 9: Make the dream feel real: the creature wakes up @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} if it succeeded at its save against the dream attack).
  • 13: Bring an ally into the dream.
  • 17: The creature forgets the dream unless it succeeds at a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
